query:
SELECT 
  s.id as sponsor_id,
  s.companyName,
  COUNT(m.id) as total_meetings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as published_meetings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.isVisible = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as visible_meetings,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested') AND m.isVisible = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as portal_visible,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.status ORDER BY m.status) as statuses,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.isVisible ORDER BY m.isVisible) as visibility_flags
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.companyName IN ('The Martec', 'Poetry')
GROUP BY s.id, s.companyName;
